notes.text: Category "100 DOLLARS" inferred: all rows on pages 441-448 are 100 $ coins (row text "100 $,..."); the denomination heading is not printed on these pages. All pages also carry the running header ARGENT.
The value table at the top of page 442 belongs to the series "Médailles de la Confédération canadienne" whose heading and photos appear at the bottom of page 441.
The value table at the top of page 443 continues the series "Majestic Animals" whose heading and photos appear on page 442.
Robert Bateman row: VALEUR column printed as "1,000" (comma); converted to 1000.00.

The top table (Émission diverses, continuation from page 447 photos) and the Le Carrousel de la GRC row are on an out-of-focus scan; values read after 2 zooms but flagged uncertain. Page 448 also starts a new category "125 DOLLARS" (series "Appel de la nature") with photos only (2014 Loup, 2015 Couguar, 2016 Grizzly, Pierre Leduc) and no value table on this page.
